decision.summary: A prolonged E descent (610–660) is well-defined with coherent interior trend, but the return phase is axis-inconsistent: E recovers rapidly while N and U do not revert, leaving the offset unconfirmed as temporary. No other temporary intervals within allowed_context [575,710] meet full onset–interior–return criteria.

intervals.observation: E shows sustained descent (~−4 MAD) from index 610 to 660; N declines modestly, U rises slightly—consistent interior shape across axes. E reverses sharply upward after 660, but N continues downward and U remains elevated, preventing a clean return on all axes.
